'''Stephen McNamara''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Montreal DPC]] on 18 August 2001 with YMSYL, according to Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2963">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-montreal-dpc-from-the-overall-1st-placed2963/ montreal-dpc-from-the-overall-1st-place], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 15 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-15-montreal-dpc-from-the-overall-1st-placed2963/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
